meta.description: F2 Internal VOS Knowledge Bank - for WBR/MBR callout use

entries.sellerQuote: We can't use GWD for new launches at all — the single-SKU full-box requirement means any product with size variants is automatically excluded. We'd need to completely change how we ship to even test it.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: GWD 根本没法用于新品——单 SKU 满箱发货的要求意味着有尺寸变体的产品直接被排除在外。我们需要完全改变发货方式才能测试。
entries.summary: GWD 混箱限制是最核心准入障碍，F2 卖家以流程验证为目的，尚未进入降本决策阶段。三项核心障碍：①混箱不支持；②大型 SKU 尺寸限制；③报关强绑定 AGL 导致约 2 周 onboarding 延误。
entries.summary_en: Mixed-SKU restriction is the primary GWD barrier. F2 sellers are in process-validation mode, not yet optimizing for cost. Three blockers: no mixed-SKU support, large-SKU size limits, and AGL customs binding adding ~2-week onboarding delay.
entries.keyInsight: GWD 混箱限制让新品卖家完全无法参与

entries.sellerQuote: The reference price rules are pushing me to sell at full price more, but I haven't actually lowered my everyday price. I just stopped running as many promotions. It's not really EDLP — it's just less discounting.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: 参考价规则让我更多时候按原价销售，但我实际并没有降低日常价格。我只是减少了促销活动。这不是真正的 EDLP，只是促销减少而已。
entries.summary: 参考价政策推动全价销售占比提升，但尚未实现结构性降价——日常售价无显著下降。卖家普遍转向 BXGY（买赠工具），因其不受 was price 规则约束。两项运营痛点：外部比价系统误抓黄牛低价导致 Buy Box 被压制；政策规则边界模糊（如 95% 阈值）。
entries.summary_en: Reference price policy increased full-price sales but has not driven structural everyday price reductions. Sellers broadly shifted to BXGY. Two pain points: external price trackers picking up scalper prices suppress Buy Box; and the 95% rule boundary is unclear, forcing trial-and-error.
entries.keyInsight: EDLP 政策成效更接近「促销减少」而非「日常价格下降」

entries.sellerQuote: I had started cutting prices for the fee benefit, but then the UK RRP regulation kicked in. I can't risk setting a price that becomes my reference and then can't be used for PD. So I held my price after WK18.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: 我开始降价以获得费率优惠，但英国 RRP 新规生效了。我不能冒险设置一个价格，结果成了参考价然后没法用于 PD。所以 WK18 之后我就停止降价了。
entries.summary: 费率减免对降价行为拉动明显，降价 FBA BA 份额持续增长至 WK18。WK18 后收窄——PD 规则要求活动价低于 T30 参考价 5%，叠加英国建议零售价新政（4/23 生效），F2 卖家主动在 PD 前按住价格。Band A 仍在小幅降价，Band B 已止降。
entries.summary_en: Fee incentive drove meaningful price-cut behavior through WK18. Post-WK18 pullback driven by PD rules (5% below T30) combined with UK RRP regulation (effective 4/23). Band A still cutting modestly; Band B has stopped. Sellers are strategically holding prices ahead of PD.
entries.keyInsight: UK RRP 新规与 PD 参考价规则叠加，导致 EU 费率激励效果在 WK18 后自我收窄

entries.sellerQuote: The fee savings just aren't enough to justify launching new EU-specific products. The price competition is so much worse in EU — we can barely make margin on our existing assortment.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: 节省的费用根本不足以支撑为 EU 专门开发新品。EU 的价格竞争比美国激烈得多——我们现有产品的利润空间已经很薄了。
entries.summary: 上新端卖家调研（53 家）：77%（41/53）不会纯粹因费率政策增加 EU 上新，核心原因是 EU 价格竞争力弱、利润空间不足。23%（12/53）愿意增加，其中 75% 计划增幅约 5%。路径上，85% 将 US 现有选品同步至 EU，仅 15% 为 EU 专属开款。
entries.summary_en: New selection survey (53 sellers): 77% (41/53) would not increase EU launches purely due to the fee incentive — insufficient margin. 23% (12/53) would increase, with 75% planning ~5% growth. 85% are extending existing US assortment to EU; only 15% developing EU-exclusive products.
entries.keyInsight: 77% 卖家表示 EU 费率激励不足以驱动新品上新，利润空间是核心阻碍

entries.sellerQuote: Switching to AGL for customs just to use GWD adds two weeks minimum. Our current freight partner has been with us for years. It's not just paperwork — it's operational risk during a live selling season.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: 为了用 GWD 而切换到 AGL 报关，至少要加两周时间。我们现在的货代合作多年了。这不只是文件问题，是旺季运营风险。
entries.summary: GWD 报关要求强绑定 AGL，卖家现有供应商切换带来约 2 周 onboarding 延误。对于旺季期间的卖家而言，切换货代是高风险决策。最易 convert 画像：SKU 变体简单、单品出货量大、已有 AWD 经验。
entries.summary_en: GWD requires AGL customs binding, adding ~2-week onboarding delay when sellers switch freight partners. Switching during active selling season is high operational risk. Easiest-to-convert profile: simple SKU variants, high per-unit volume, prior AWD experience.
entries.keyInsight: AGL 强绑定造成 2 周延误，旺季期间卖家不愿切换货代

entries.sellerQuote: Some price scraper picked up a scalper price for my ASIN and now my Buy Box is suppressed because it thinks there's a cheaper offer somewhere. I filed a dispute but it's been two weeks with no response.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: 某个比价工具抓到了我 ASIN 的一个黄牛价，现在我的 Buy Box 被压制了，系统以为外面有更便宜的。我提了申诉，两周了没有回应。
entries.summary: 外部比价系统误抓黄牛低价，导致正常 ASIN Buy Box 被压制，流量转化直接受损。申诉 SLA 过长（>2周无回应）是核心痛点。政策规则边界模糊（如 95% 阈值），卖家依赖试错应对。
entries.summary_en: External price trackers picking up scalper prices suppress Buy Box on legitimate ASINs, directly impacting conversion. Dispute SLA is too slow (>2 weeks). Policy boundary (95% threshold) unclear, forcing trial-and-error compliance.
entries.keyInsight: 黄牛比价误判导致 Buy Box 压制，申诉 SLA 超 2 周

entries.sellerQuote: FBA fees went up again. At this point my margins on standard-size items are below 10%. I'm seriously considering switching some SKUs to FBM or a 3PL.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: FBA 费用又涨了。现在我的标准件利润率已经低于 10%。我在认真考虑把部分 SKU 切换到 FBM 或第三方仓。
entries.summary: 2026 年 FBA 配送费上调（美国站约 5%，欧洲站部分尺寸 8%），卖家利润空间被压缩，部分卖家开始评估 FBM 或海外仓替代方案。对 F2 卖家影响尤其明显，因其利润空间本身较薄。
entries.summary_en: 2026 FBA fee increase (~5% US, up to 8% EU on some sizes) is compressing seller margins. Sellers with standard-size items reporting <10% margins are evaluating FBM or 3PL alternatives. Impact is disproportionate on F2 sellers with already-thin margins.
entries.keyInsight: FBA 费用上调导致部分 F2 卖家利润率跌破 10%，FBM 转移风险上升

entries.sellerQuote: Getting started in Japan is extremely expensive. Between the translation, FBA fees, and low initial traffic, we burned through our testing budget in 6 weeks without meaningful sales.
entries.sellerQuote_cn: 在日本起步极其昂贵。日语翻译、FBA 费用加上初期流量极低，6 周就烧完了我们的测试预算，销售额微乎其微。
entries.summary: JP 站 cold start 成本高：本地化（翻译）成本 + FBA 费用 + 初期流量不足三重叠加，导致卖家测试预算快速耗尽。SP 广告 CPC 高且点击转化率低，新品冷启动周期比 US/EU 更长。
entries.summary_en: JP cold start faces triple cost burden: localization (translation), FBA fees, and low initial traffic. SP ad CPC is high with low initial conversion. New product cold-start cycle significantly longer than US/EU. Testing budget burns fast without meaningful early sales.
entries.keyInsight: JP 冷启动三重成本（本地化+FBA+低流量）令 F2 卖家测试预算快速耗尽
